relevance.rationale: *** WRONG JOIN ***. The seeded id points at a two-author 1994 quantum-dilogarithm entry. The document is a SINGLE-author paper on the asymptotic expansion of the Kashaev invariant of the 5_2 knot - a different author, a different decade and a different result. id set to null: references.ts registers a different, two-author paper by the same first author on two-bridge Kashaev asymptotics and twisted Reidemeister torsion (ohtsuki-takata2015), but nothing matching this single-author 5_2-specific document, and no identifier in the corpus resolves to it. Judged on merits this is a CORE-relevance document, not background. The corpus's Q_beta / resurgence chapter is built almost entirely on the 5_2 knot - QOU/QBeta/FiveTwoDTSpectrumSplit.lean, StokesQZeroDTCount.lean, BarOddQOneCentringNonselective.lean, IotaOddSaddleOffsetAmphichiral.lean and GZWeightGeneral.lean all read 5_2 data out of a SINGLE source (garoufalidis-gu-marino2021) - and this document supplies the independent asymptotic side: the asymptotic expansion of the 5_2 Kashaev invariant, with the hyperbolic volume and Chern-Simons invariant as the leading term, plus a method for the full Poincare asymptotics to all orders. That makes it a genuine external cross-check rather than a duplicate.

keyResults.statement: Presentation of the asymptotic expansion of the Kashaev invariant of the 5_2 knot, with leading term the hyperbolic volume and Chern-Simons invariant, plus a method computing the full Poincare asymptotics to all orders.
keyResults.useForFolio: An independent all-orders 5_2 asymptotic series to cross-check the corpus's 5_2 Stokes/DT-spectrum readings, which currently rest on a single source (garoufalidis-gu-marino2021).

proposedActions.rationale: The corpus's 5_2 programme depends on one source for its 5_2 numbers; this in-repo paper is the independent asymptotic source and has no ref() entry. Register it from the title page (note [ohtsuki-takata2015] is a DIFFERENT, already-registered paper sharing this document's first author - do not reuse that key).

Once registered, the all-orders 5_2 Poincare asymptotics give a parameter-free comparison against the large-order amplitude the corpus extracts from the GGM Stokes constants - a genuine external check rather than an internal consistency test.
